title: universalHomeomorphism_pullback
statement: For a universal homeomorphism u : X' → X and any g : Y → X, pullback.fst g u is universal; its additive upper-star/lower-star adjunction is an equivalence and its cohomology pullback is bijective. The four displayed etale and star base-change isomorphisms exist, and the resulting cohomology square commutes.

proof.text: Stability of universal homeomorphisms under base change makes pullback.fst g u a universal homeomorphism. Apply topological invariance to it: its additive upperStar is an equivalence, so the unit and counit of upperStarLowerStarAdjunction are isomorphisms, and cohomologyMap_bijective gives the asserted cohomology bijections.

Construct the set-valued inverse-image square by composing the sheaf pullback adjunctions with Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso and lowerStarComp, using pullback.condition to name the common composite. Compose the compositor on the snd/u path with the inverse compositor on the fst/g path. For additive sheaves compose the inverse upperStarComp on the snd/u path with upperStarComp on the fst/g path.

For U = u^*, S = (pullback.snd g u)^*, G = g^*, P = (pullback.fst g u)^*, write the inverse-image square as U ⋙ S ≅ G ⋙ P. Insert the inverse counit to identify S ⋙ P_* with u_* ⋙ U ⋙ S ⋙ P_*. Whisker the square isomorphism to obtain u_* ⋙ G ⋙ P ⋙ P_*, then cancel P ⋙ P_* by the inverse unit. Functor associators and unitors give the displayed mixed isomorphism. For set-valued sheaves lowerStar is an equivalence by topological invariance, hence the unit and counit of its left adjoint are invertible; for additive sheaves upperStar is an equivalence. The private proved helper mixedSquareIso implements this construction in both coefficient categories.

The proved helper cohomologyMap_comp_cancel first substitutes an arbitrary named composite h = f ≫ g, then uses the composition clause of cohomologyPullbackFunctorial and Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply to cancel the forward compositor with its inverse. Apply it to each path in the square, taking h = pullback.fst g u ≫ g and using pullback.condition on the snd/u path. Both sides become cohomologyMap h F q x.
